channel.title: Sufi Ilham — Books
channel.description: New releases from Sufi Ilham (MD Naiyer Alam). Latest: The Ninth Bell.

item.title: The Ninth Bell
item.description: On an island cut off by a storm, a letter writer and a bell restorer confront grief, secrets and the courage to be known.

item.title: The Caregiving Launch Plan
item.description: A practical 90-day guide to navigating care, paperwork, family conversations and the responsibilities of a new caregiver.

item.title: First Person Singular
item.description: An exploration of consciousness, neuroscience and philosophy, asking what it means to experience the world from the inside.

item.title: دریا کا ایک حصہ
item.description: A free Urdu novella by Sufi Ilham — read the whole book online, completely free.

item.title: नसरुद्दीन की टेढ़ी तराज़ू
item.description: In 13th-century Anatolia, Mullah Nasruddin weighs more than goods on his crooked scale — he weighs conscience. A witty historical-folkloric novel about justice, power, faith, and what a person is truly worth.

item.title: The Quiet Tenancy
item.description: Paid to live ninety days in a Brooklyn brownstone and notice everything, Cassie Adler finds the house keeping a schedule of its own — and learns she was chosen for a reason.

item.title: The Spare Key Summer
item.description: She came home to help her mother sell the laundromat. She didn’t expect to find a reason to stay — a standalone slow-burn romance set over one Milwaukee summer.

item.title: The Compass of the Dead
item.description: The compass points at anything not yet paid for. Cassia and Elias walk the road of the standing dead — and the Trust is waiting with terms.

item.title: The Tide of Unmade Days
item.description: Saltmere’s unmapped street has surfaced with bills for a day no one lived — and a drowned bell scheduled to ring again.

item.title: The Map of Tomorrow
item.description: Every night, a map appears showing events that have not happened yet. The newest one shows Cassia’s death — and the name of a man dead for twenty-seven years.

item.title: The Citadel of Sapphire Seas
item.description: King Valen rules a wall-less city of peace — until Master Theron arrives with twelve wagons of scrolls to correct the king’s heart.

item.title: The Chariot of Peace
item.description: On the Plain of Sundered Vows, Arjan casts down his bow — and his unarmed charioteer smiles as time itself stops.

item.title: The Eden of Sunspire
item.description: In the valley of Sunspire, Valen’s flute can calm shadow serpents — and his bond with Elora is an unbreakable sanctuary against the dark.

item.title: The Sea Tithe
item.description: On the run with the bond that follows them everywhere, Neris and Calden are hunted by the woman who taught the Tithe its manners.

item.title: The Crown Always Owns
item.description: Inland, shadows do not arrive at all. The Crown has never needed permission to own something — and Neris is done asking for one.

item.title: The Shadow Tithe
item.description: A forger who hides magic from the Crown, and the collector sent to hunt her — bound together by a gold seal that neither of them chose.

item.title: The River's Portion
item.description: A relic authenticator and a face-restorer in the city of Nahrabad, a pressed flower in a Qur’an, and a house that still remembers the flood of 2002.

item.title: The Christmas Letters of Maple Falls
item.description: A city girl who always leaves, a single-dad dairy farmer who never does, and a seven-year-old’s letter to Santa asking for someone who will stay.

item.title: A Second Chance in Maple Falls
item.description: Ten years after he left for Silicon Valley, he’s back with city shoes and a second chance. She’s not sure she wants to give it.

item.title: A Wedding at the End of Maple Street
item.description: A wedding planner who doesn’t believe in her own love story, and the fire chief who stopped believing in weddings eight years ago.

item.title: The Bookshop at the End of Maple Street
item.description: A burned-out Manhattan editor inherits her late aunt’s failing bookshop — and collides with the grumpy carpenter who has loved the place his whole life.

item.title: A Recipe for Maple Falls
item.description: A fallen food critic, the small-town baker he once destroyed, and one perfect pear cardamom pie that undoes thirty years of silence.

item.title: Moh Tera Prem: Where Attachment Ends and Love Begins
item.description: Moh is the love that grips; prem is the love that asks nothing back. Thirty-two contemplations on the boundary between attachment and love — for the reader awake at 2 a.m.

item.title: PREM: The Ancient Path of Selfless, Unconditional Love
item.description: The ancient Sanskrit path of selfless, unconditional love — from the bhakti poets, the Sufis, the Upanishads and the Buddha.

item.title: Laozi: The Man Who Disappeared into the Dao
item.description: A biography of a man whose historical footprint is almost invisible and whose philosophical shadow stretches across two and a half millennia — with a guided reading of the Daodejing in twelve movements.

item.title: The Wall Was a Gesture
item.description: A philosophical work in twenty-two chapters — from the quiet sense of being a separate self to the peace of seeing that the world was never outside you.

item.title: The Map Is Finished
item.description: "The map is not the country. Walk until you know the difference." One continuous journey in twenty chapters through attention, freedom, and what remains when the map ends.

item.title: The Human Operating Manual
item.description: The manual you should have been issued at birth. 111 diagrams, 34 worksheets and 10 system modules that treat your life as a living system of energy, emotion, attention and habit.

item.title: NeuroFocus Protocol
item.description: Uncover the hidden strengths of ADHD — creativity, fast thinking, hyperfocus — and design a life that works with your brain instead of against it.

item.title: The Infinite Classroom
item.description: Life never stopped teaching — most of us simply stopped attending. A journey of learning from birth to beyond, for those brave enough to turn the page.

item.title: Fractured Time
item.description: What if time isn't real — but a beautiful lie you've been hypnotized into believing? A bold unraveling of one of the greatest illusions you've ever lived by.

item.title: Belief Unveiled
item.description: A journey into the hidden architecture of your mind, revealing how unconscious beliefs silently dictate your reality — and exactly how to rewrite them.
